Ported from SqlCapture.java:60-66 and SqlTraceRecorder.hasWrappedDataSource (v2.3.0:530-553), with sharpit's recorders in the text (SQLAlchemy 2.0+ and the sqlite3 module). The fact is per context and write-once: a SQLAlchemy engine ever in the context's registry (EngineRegistry.seen_any; engines are held weakly), or a statement of either source routed to the context (CaptureState.sql_delivered, set in dispatch.recording before the pause and suspend filters). Deviation, DEFAULT TAKEN, owner may reverse: BootUI knows the DataSource at wrap time; an engine sharpit never registered (no database panel, or connected before the install) and raw sqlite3 (no wrap-time object) count from their first statement here, so before it a SQL check reads UNAVAILABLE (fails closed). R2DBC has no analogue.
